body:
The issue here is that the WORKSPACE file under /usr/local which is specified in this error message is expecting only a grpc_archive rule while bazel is supplying a http_archive rule as well as a grpc_archive rule. The workaround here is to remove the else condition that fails the build if it doesn't receive a grpc_archive rule.
This way WORKSPACE file would ignore the http_archive rule and proceed with compilation on receiving the grpc_archive rule
Basically - 
 ```
 for dep in rem:
    rule = dep.pop("rule")
    if "grpc_archive" == rule:
      grpc_archive(**dep)
    else:
       fail("Unknown loading rule %s for %s" % (rule, dep))

```
To

 ```
 for dep in rem:
    rule = dep.pop("rule")
    if "grpc_archive" == rule:
      grpc_archive(**dep)
```
I am experiencing the same issue.
A quick and dirty workaround to get C++ build working locally is to comment out this line https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/4982d915ccebd17492402b09e91435412ff9df29/WORKSPACE#L62
I have a patch in the works that migrates the Bazel build to use https://github.com/stackb/rules_proto

The fix for this is here:

https://github.com/jdwestbro/grpc/commit/f1ab0cdd8161266511dce0965c2bcb701e178167

body:
@mhaidrygoog  can come up with a PR that fixes this problem? It seems that you have some good insight into what's causing this problem.

@jdwestbro  is migrating over to stackb/rules_proto really necessary in order to fix the problem? (there might be good reasons to migrate over, but here we are mostly trying to fix the bazel build for bazel 0.23+)
FTR pasting a link to the problematic rule https://github.com/pubref/rules_protobuf/blob/99043441e3c473809f633f5ad049945606124b60/cpp/rules.bzl#L27
@gnossen  it seems that this problem is because of the ways our python bazel build is setup (see `py_proto_repositories()` in our WORKSPACE - it might need some massaging). Can you help?
Sure if there's a simpler fix let's go with that. I thought stackb/rules_proto would be a drop-in replacement but there are some issues to resolve with protobuf code generation.
